integrity: The infinite argument is symbolic: a complement-closed divisor-box identity proves strong pseudoperfectness, a Mersenne perfect-power obstruction proves primitivity, and elementary logarithmic growth proves the counting law. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives an explicit primitive subfamily, not a classification or a maximal progression. It does not address the paper's odd-primitive infinitude question. The counting law is only for the displayed subfamily.
title: Primitive arithmetic progressions inside every Wang–Zelinsky construction row
